# Sarveshwar Singh - SunVeda Technologies

> Tokyo-based software engineer connecting user needs, technical requirements, and software delivery. Working across full-stack software, enterprise systems, and decentralised technology since 2010.

Sarveshwar Singh works with a trusted team on technical development through SunVeda Technologies, his sole-proprietor trade name. His technical work spans blockchain/Web3 systems (EVM networks, Solana, Cardano, Canton Network), cloud, full-stack, and mobile development, with a growing focus on security-first architecture and AI safety review. Based in Tokyo, Japan.

- [Tech Stack](https://sunveda.tech/#stack): Tools across blockchain ecosystems (EVM, Solana, Cardano, Canton Network), frontend, and backend & infrastructure
- [Capabilities](https://sunveda.tech/#services): Software engineering support - technical requirements, product & technical roadmaps, user experience & interface design, architecture & delivery, security-first & AI safety review, and cross-market technical enablement
- [Community](https://sunveda.tech/#community): LINE OpenChat communities run outside client work - "Ima Koso AI | Learn AI Now" (AI tools) and SunnyDays Badminton Stories
- [Gallery](https://sunveda.tech/#gallery): Instagram moments from community meetups
